next.reason: 1985 states as a syntax rule that 'A RELEASE statement may be used only within the range of an input procedure associated with a SORT statement' for its file, so a violating program is refused. 2023 has no such syntax rule (14.9.32.3 SR1-4 carry none); §2023:14.9.32.4 GR1 says it 'may be executed only' there and 'If it is executed at any other time, the EC-FLOW-RELEASE exception condition is set to exist', and §2023:14.9.40.4 GR13 sets EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE when an output procedure's range executes a RELEASE. A compile-time refusal became a run-time exception condition.
